objective.text: Register several event-method mappings through one subscriber without conflating event payloads.

difficulty.rationale: Follow subscriber mappings without assuming every event invokes every subscriber method.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

files.source:
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;

class Opened
{
}

class Closed
{
}

class SessionSubscriber
{
    public function opened(Opened $event): void
    {
        echo 'O';
    }

    public function closed(Closed $event): void
    {
        echo 'C';
    }

    public function subscribe($events): array
    {
        return [
            Opened::class => 'opened',
            Closed::class => 'closed',
        ];
    }
}

Event::subscribe(SessionSubscriber::class);
Event::dispatch(new Closed());
